How to use AI as a receptionist?

Point Allo at your website or a PDF so it learns your business, pick a voice and greeting, then set your rules for booking appointments, transferring calls or taking a message. It goes live on your existing number in minutes, no code required.
Can an AI receptionist book appointments?

Yes. Allo's receptionist reads your own calendar, offers the slots that are really free and books the appointment while the caller is still on the line, then texts them the confirmation. It only offers a callback when nothing fits.
How much does an AI receptionist cost?

With Allo the receptionist takes one Business seat, $32/user/mo billed yearly, so you know the bill before the month starts. That's a fraction of the $1,000+/mo a human answering service typically charges.
What does an AI receptionist do?

It answers every inbound call 24/7, greets the caller in your brand voice, answers their questions from what you taught it, and books them straight into your calendar. It transfers the calls that need a person, then records, transcribes and summarises the call and syncs everything to your CRM automatically. The same setup works whether you run a real estate office, a law firm, an HVAC or plumbing company, a medical practice or any small business that lives on the phone.
What is the best AI receptionist?

The best one sounds human, never misses a call, and actually moves work forward instead of just taking messages. Allo is rated 4.7/5 on G2 across 205 reviews and replaces a full answering service, answering, booking, following up and updating your CRM in one place.
Can an AI receptionist handle calls?

Yes. Allo handles calls end to end and across the whole team simultaneously, no busy signals, no voicemail. It can book the appointment, transfer hot leads to you, take a detailed message, and escalate anything it isn't sure about, exactly the way you tell it to.
Can the AI receptionist transfer calls to a human?

Yes. You set the rules for every call: the AI can route the call straight to the right person on your team when a lead is hot or asks for someone specific, and it hands over with the caller's history already open. Anything else, it books or takes a detailed message. You stay in control of what gets escalated and to whom.
Which languages does the AI receptionist support?

It speaks naturally with your callers in several languages, including English, French and Spanish, and transcribes and summarises each call in the caller's language. You pick the voice and greeting your callers hear when you set it up.
